reasons: Opinion: 'There is no formula for the determination of reasonableness. Each case is to be decided on its own facts and circumstances' — supports 'judged on each case's own facts.'

Court treated the arrests as lawful warrantless arrests, consistent with 'a warrantless arrest used to justify ransacking an office.'
